prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE portrait 2:3 concept image for a lofi focus app, a miniature growing repair forge on a round charcoal-grey stone plinth floating against an absolutely pure BLACK background. Fine pixel-painted game background art: small visible pixel clusters, matte textures, nuanced midnight blue shadows, muted amber light, worn materials, quiet lived-in atmosphere. Not 3D render, not vector, not children's storybook, not crisp cartoon. Fixed elevated three-quarter camera; entire circular platform fits with black breathing room, occupies lower middle 75% of frame. No surroundings beyond the circular platform, no landscape, no text or UI. This is growth from a single ember to a cozy late-night repair workshop, NOT a weapons factory or town. Same platform and perspective across all five stages. RANK 1 OF 5. Humble beginning: only a small irregular lump of charcoal glowing deep red through cracks, lying on a shallow patch of cool ash at the center of the otherwise bare stone platform. A few tiny ember specks, a faint delicate thread of smoke, warm reflected light on the ash. Charcoal must have tactile jagged texture, not a crystal or magic gem. Very minimal and intimate, the beginning of a world. No furnace, buildings, tools, characters or vegetation yet.
